historical_growth.growth_rate_source: equity_5yr_cagr (2.8%) cross-checked to revenue_5yr_cagr (2.7%); used as the terminal rate, not the near-term path, which is a VBP trough-and-recovery
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Owner-FCF CAGR (11-14%) diverges >30% from equity/revenue CAGR (~3%): the FCF growth is capex normalisation from the FY2021 build-out peak (RMB1,309m -> 574m) and working-capital release, not earnings growth. Equity CAGR is depressed by ~RMB2bn of buybacks and a 60%+ payout. FY2026 will break the FCF series downward (-20% H1 revenue).
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF series = reported FCF - 0 SBC - interest income: FY2020 1,338; FY2022 1,517; FY2025 2,273 (CNY m). CAGRs computed FY2022->FY2025 (3yr) and FY2020->FY2025 (5yr).

scenario_narratives.base: A pricing-driven trough, not a structural collapse: FY2026 revenue falls ~15% on the concentrated Ilaprazole/menotropins/leuprorelin/fluvoxamine price resets, then grows low-single-digits as Imexpharm annualises and the follow-on pipeline (Lecankitug, aripiprazole microspheres, JP-1366, GnRH antagonists) replaces eroding legacy SKUs. EBITDA margin holds 26.5-27.5% (the FY2024-25 range), capex ~= D&A at 5.5% of revenue, 30% combined tax and minority leakage, 9% CNY WACC, 13x terminal cap. The axes are VBP cadence versus pipeline conversion.
scenario_narratives.bull: Innovation inflection: Lecankitug (first-in-China IL-17A/F, head-to-head superiority over Cosentyx) and the P-CAB/antipsychotic launches scale fast enough to deliver 6-8% growth in FY2027-29 and 29.5% margins; overseas (Imexpharm, Indonesia) becomes a second engine. 15x terminal cap, 3% terminal growth.
scenario_narratives.bear: The cost-containment cycle keeps cutting: revenue declines through FY2030 to ~RMB8.7bn, margin 20%, NCI leakage 32% combined, 10x cap, 1.5% terminal growth. Even here the net cash and investment portfolio (~RMB6.6bn after the dividends) underpin a large share of the price.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value the attributable owner cash flow of a net-cash Chinese pharma through a VBP-driven trough, charging minority leakage and tax once in the flows, stripping all investment income and putting every matching asset (cash, deposits, funds, associates, FVOCI instruments) into the bridge at carrying value, and deducting the two dividends the price has already gone ex. Risk is carried in the scenario paths and a 25% bear weight, not in a stacked discount rate. The terminal cap (10-15x owner FCF) is deliberately below Gordon because the business is structurally exposed to administered pricing.
key_risks_to_valuation: VBP / medical-insurance renegotiation cadence: each round is a step-down in revenue with no offsetting volume for the affected SKUs; the base assumes FY2026 absorbs most of it, the bear assumes it recurs annually to FY2030
Pipeline conversion: Lecankitug, JP-1366 and the long-acting antipsychotics are approved or filed but not yet commercial at scale; the base growth recovery from FY2028 depends on them

Bridge quality: RMB1.36bn single asset management plan (already marked down 13% in six months) and RMB469m unlisted equity are taken at carrying value; a 50% haircut would remove ~RMB1.0/share (~HKD1.2)
Minority leakage drift: NCI took 16.8% of H1 2026 profit and the 32% Imexpharm minority adds to it; each 1pp of leakage is ~1.4% of value
Controlling-shareholder governance (Joincare 47%) and the persistent ~50% A/H premium: the H-share may never close the gap to intrinsic value, which the 15% hurdle entry price partly addresses
FX: CNY flows against an HKD quote; a 5% CNY depreciation moves every HKD figure by 5%, and refresh_price.py does not update fx_rate

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 19.80-33.40 HKD. FX from Yahoo CNYHKD=X cross-checked to USDHKD/USDCNY.
data_sources.financials: 1513.HK_Metrics.csv (core_metrics, CNY millions, CAS); Interim Report 2026 (balance sheet, cash flow, notes V.2/V.8/V.9/V.11/V.21/V.29/V.33, share-capital table); Annual Report 2025 (income statement, cash-flow supplement D&A, note V.55 tax, option scheme, buybacks).
data_sources.qualitative: 1513.HK_Analysis.json (2026-10-17): segment mix, VBP exposure, Imexpharm acquisition, Lecankitug approval, dividend announcements.

inputs.sbc_source: SBC-zero: no share-based payment line in the FY2025 cash-flow supplement or equity statement; the 2022 Share Option Incentive Scheme has granted zero options (FY2025 AR 'Total number of shares issuable'). Rows kept explicit at 0%.
inputs.buyback_note: FY2025 financing outflow RMB579.9m (A+H repurchases, ~RMB600m cancelled Dec-2025); H1 2026 only RMB12.8m. The flat count is funded by an active repurchaser, not a modelling convention.
inputs.fx_note: CNY->HKD 1.1726 (Yahoo CNYHKD=X, 2026-10-16). Cross-check USDHKD 7.8475 / USDCNY 6.6754 = 1.1756 (0.3% tie). The A-share (000513.SZ, CNY 27.95 = HKD 32.78 at this rate) trades at a ~54% premium to the H-share, so the dual listing cannot parity-check the rate; the USD cross does. Per-share values are computed in CNY and converted at this rate; refresh_price.py moves the price but not this rate.
inputs.share_count_basis: 887,907,171 A+H shares at 30 June 2026 (Interim Report 2026 share-capital table), unchanged from 31 Dec 2025. No dilutive instruments: diluted EPS equals basic in FY2025 and H1 2026 and the 2022 option scheme has granted nothing. Held FLAT (SBC-zero; buybacks are value-neutral in this model).
inputs.wacc_rationale: WACC 9.0% built in CNY: 10-yr CGB ~1.8%, China ERP ~6.5% (mature 4.5% + country premium), beta ~1.0 for a policy-exposed China pharma => CoE ~8.3%; net-cash balance sheet so WACC ~= CoE; rounded up to 9.0%. Same rate in all three scenarios: VBP/pricing risk is charged in the scenario flows and weights, not stacked into the discount rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: (A) leases as debt: lease liabilities RMB34.4m (15.9 current + 18.5 non-current, 30 June 2026) included in total_debt; no lease principal deducted from flows; ROU depreciation sits inside D&A. Immaterial either way (lease interest RMB0.9m per half).
inputs.nci_treatment: Attributable-only flows: minority interests (FY2025 16.1% of net profit, H1 2026 16.8%, rising with the 32% Imexpharm minority) are folded into cash_tax_rate_path as a combined tax+NCI leakage rate (~17% income tax x ~17% NCI => 30% base). NCI book value (RMB1,231.9m) is therefore NOT deducted in the bridge. Calibration: FY2025 operating EBIT ~RMB2,665m x 0.70 = 1,866 vs attributable net profit ex non-operating/investment items ~1,890.
inputs.ebitda_definition: Operating EBITDA excludes interest income, investment income (associates, funds, asset-management plans), fair-value gains and non-operating items; every stripped income stream has its asset in net cash or equity_bridge. Government grants in 'other income' (~RMB125m) are treated as recurring and left in. Asset impairments (mostly inventory) are left in as a cost. FY2025: EBIT 2,665 + D&A 603.8 = 3,269 = 27.2% of revenue; FY2024 27.5%; H1 2026 31.2% (H1 2025 31.1%) with H2 seasonally ~23%.
inputs.net_cash_components: Cash and bank balances RMB7,440.8m (restricted 4.0m) less short-term borrowings 3,395.8 + long-term borrowings 25.9 + lease liabilities 34.4 = net cash 3,984.7 at 30 June 2026 (post the RMB1,557m Imexpharm cash outlay). Cash fell from 9,305 at Dec-2025 as structured deposits were rolled into a RMB1.36bn single asset management plan (see bridge).
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF component DCF (SKILL.md routing: non-US operating company + adaptations a/b/c/d/e). Fresh build 2026-10-17. FY0 = FY2025 (revenue 12,020.35); Y1 = FY2026E, built off H1 2026 (-20.3% YoY, chemical drugs -25.3% on Ilaprazole/menotropins insurance renegotiation, Guangdong alliance pricing on leuprorelin, 11th VBP fluvoxamine) plus ~RMB350m of Imexpharm consolidated from June. The valuation date sits ten months into Y1, so discounting Y1 a full period is slightly conservative. Working capital: manufacturer (receivables+notes+inventory ~4.5bn vs payables ~1.3bn), so wc_capture is negative: the revenue decline releases cash in FY2026 (as H1 2026 OCF +4.5% on -20% revenue showed) and growth consumes it later. SBC-zero market: house and street coincide, band_position null. Price is ex both the FY2025 final (ex 2026-06-16) and the special interim (ex 2026-10-14); both are deducted in the bridge since the 30-June balance sheet still carried the cash.

bear.narrative: Successive VBP rounds and insurance renegotiations keep cutting 5-8% a year off the legacy chemical-drug and TCM base through FY2029, the pipeline is too small to offset, EBITDA margin compresses to 20% as selling-expense cuts run out, NCI leakage rises with Imexpharm, and the exit multiple is 10x. Capex runs below D&A as the asset base shrinks.

base.growth_note: FY2026E -15%: H1 -20.3%, H2 legacy ~-15% vs a RMB5.75bn H2 2025 base that pre-dates most of the price resets, plus ~RMB350m Imexpharm. FY2027 +2% = full-year Imexpharm (~+3pp) against a legacy base still absorbing the 11th VBP round. FY2028-30 4-4.5% as Lecankitug, aripiprazole microspheres, JP-1366 and the GnRH follow-ons scale; fades to 2.5%.
base.margin_note: FY2026E 26.5% (H1 31.2% actual, H2 seasonally ~23% with selling-expense cuts offsetting price cuts); recovers to 27.5% = the FY2024-25 level as mix shifts to higher-margin complex formulations and biologics. No expansion beyond history.
base.cash_tax_rate_note: Combined income tax (~16-17% effective, high-tech enterprise rates) and minority-interest leakage (~17%): 1 - 0.83 x 0.84 = 30%.
base.terminal_note: Cap 13x owner FCF (post-tax, post-NCI) for a structurally VBP-exposed business; Gordon at 9%/2.5% would imply ~16x.

bull.narrative: Lecankitug wins NRDL listing and takes meaningful IL-17 share from Cosentyx/Taltz, JP-1366 P-CAB launches into the PPI franchise it cannibalises, long-acting antipsychotics ramp, and Imexpharm plus the Indonesia API plant lift overseas mix; margins reach 29.5% on mix. Capex runs ahead of D&A to fund it.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 13x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 25%: further VBP rounds are stated government policy, the H1 2026 step-down was the largest in the company's history, and ~RMB1.8bn of the bridge sits in an opaque asset-management plan and unlisted equity. Bull cut from 35% to 25% because it needs three independent launches (Lecankitug, JP-1366, long-acting antipsychotics) and an overseas integration to all work. Base 50%.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
